issue.title: UInput emits input event twice when using v-model with debounce
issue.body:
### Environment

- @acme/ui: 1.1.0
- Vue: 3.4.21
- Nuxt: 3.12.0

### Description

`UInput` fires the `update:modelValue` event twice for a single keystroke when a debounced watcher is attached to the bound ref. This causes our search box to fire two requests per character.

### Reproduction

https://github.com/priyad/acme-input-debounce-repro

### Expected behavior

One keystroke should emit exactly one update event.
